PLAN "Upper-Body Strength for Climber - Right Shoulder Impingement Management"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build upper-body strength within pain-free range"
  GOAL secondary strength:
    name "Improve shoulder stability and scapular control for climbing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Control and Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Push and Pull A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
          scapular_retraction 2x12
          external_rotation 2x12
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 30 seconds
          lat_stretch 30 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2 minutes
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Upper Pull and Push B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
          prone_T 2x10
          external_rotation 2x12
        main straight_sets:
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
